bullets.text: A sudden fire accident occurred yesterday at the lamp lighting area of the Thiruvallur temple in Thiruttani, and the office should monitor temple safety measures.
The metro rail service between Poonamallee and Vadapalani is set to launch on October 11, and the district team should track ticket pricing details.
An Indian student confronted Nvidia executive Josh Parker during Climate Week NYC regarding AI infrastructure environmental damage, and our portfolio team should watch AI sustainability discussions.
Researchers are exploring how artificial intelligence can help decode the genetic history and 65000 years of ancestry in India, and the digital services team should follow these findings.
